## What does this change?

<!-- e.g. "Adds a guide for Ficus elastica" or "Fixes the watering tip for golden-pothos (closes #12)" -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Each new or changed guide cites **at least 2 sources**, with at least one from an authoritative publisher (RHS, Kew, a botanic garden, a university extension service or ASPCA)
- [ ] Every care fact I added or changed is backed by one of the listed sources
- [ ] Pet tags (`pet safe`, `toxic to pets`) are backed by an ASPCA or university extension page
- [ ] The file is `content/guides/<id>.json` and `id` matches the file name
- [ ] Text fits the limits: hook 60, outro 70, step title 28, tip 110, stat 16 characters; 4 to 6 steps including water and light
- [ ] `npm run validate:guides` passes
- [ ] I checked the guide in the app with `npm run dev`
